summary: Successfully completed frontend testing of Careers page navigation dropdown implementation. All features working correctly - navigation shows 3 items (Overview standalone, Our Culture dropdown, Find Your Role dropdown), dropdowns open/close correctly, all navigation items work, active states are properly highlighted, click-outside-to-close works, and responsive design functions on mobile/tablet.
passed_tests: - Careers navigation shows 3 items: Overview (standalone), Our Culture (dropdown), Find Your Role (dropdown)
- Shows 3 items: Why Work Here, Life at DataVision, How We Hire
- Shows 4 items: Open Positions, Students & Graduates, Expert Network, Register as Expert
- Overview tab highlighted when active (red text and border)
- Our Culture dropdown highlighted when viewing Why Work Here, Life at DataVision, or How We Hire tabs
- Find Your Role dropdown highlighted when viewing Open Positions, Students & Graduates, Expert Network, or Register tabs
- Dropdown closes when clicking outside the navigation area
- All 3 navigation items visible (icons only, no text labels)
- Dropdowns open correctly and display all items
- All 3 navigation items visible with labels
context_for_next_testing_agent: Careers page navigation was reorganized from 8 horizontal tabs to 3 items (1 standalone + 2 dropdowns). Key test IDs: careers-tab-overview, careers-dropdown-culture, careers-dropdown-opportunities, careers-tab-why-us, careers-tab-life, careers-tab-process, careers-tab-jobs, careers-tab-students, careers-tab-experts, careers-tab-register. Dropdowns use Framer Motion animations and click-outside-to-close functionality. Tab contents use URL query params (?tab=xxx).
